summary.text: Nicole Chavez is a Republican state representative from District 31 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career includes sales and outreach work at Presbyterian Health Plan and founding a victims' advocacy organization.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Chavez worked as director of sales, outreach and retention for Presbyterian Health Plan, according to Ballotpedia.
She has served as president of the Jackson Middle School PTA, is a member of the National Rifle Association and founded Robbed New Mexico, a victims' advocacy organization.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked to strengthen New Mexico's criminal justice system and victims' rights.
Chavez took office on January 1, 2025, and for 2025-2026 is assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and the Health and Human Services Committee.
